standard_prerequisites.name: Box-diamond interplay in maximal consistent sets
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts between Box-membership and Diamond-membership when reading R^Sigma from set inclusions.

standard_prerequisites.use: Item 3: extends the constructed Sigma-consistent set Gamma to a complete maximal consistent set Delta_3.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 787-800), three items: Diamond A -> Box A makes the canonical frame partially functional; Diamond A <-> Box A makes it functional; Box Box A -> Box A makes it weakly dense.

Item 1 (proof lines 802-815): from R Delta1 Delta2 and R Delta1 Delta3 both Box-inverse inclusions hold (by lem:box-iff-diamond); for Delta2 subseteq Delta3 take A in Delta2, so Diamond A in Delta1, the schema plus deductive closure give Box A in Delta1, and the R Delta1 Delta3 inclusion yields A in Delta3; the reverse inclusion is symmetric.
Item 2 (lines 817-819): follows immediately from item 1 and the seriality proof of thm:completeframeprops.

Item 3 (lines 820-883): for R Delta1 Delta2 construct Gamma = Box-inverse Delta1 union Diamond Delta2; consistency by contradiction - a refutation yields Box A_i in Delta1 and B_j in Delta2 with A_1..A_n, Diamond B_1..Diamond B_m proving falsum, from which the schema and the biconditional chain derive a contradiction; Lindenbaum then extends Gamma to Delta3 witnessing weak density.
proof_roadmap: Item 1: double inclusion through the schema and deductive closure.
Item 2: immediate from item 1 plus seriality.
Item 3: consistency of the constructed union by contradiction, then Lindenbaum.
difficulty_reason: Schematic axioms to frame properties (statement 787-800, proof 802-883): items 1 and 3 carried in full (set-inclusion manipulation and a consistency-by-contradiction with Lindenbaum); item 2 is a terse immediate consequence naming its two inputs. H2.
